postKillEscalation.text: 🌪️ THE HERALD struck Stonebridge in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)

callLines.text: 📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold answers! Sofia Tanaka and Kira Vega will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
Closer bonds with Emberhold could bring more volunteers. For now, these are the people they can spare.
— Stonebridge answers! Tariq Delgado and Lena Reyes will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)

commit1Lines.text: 🛡️ Joaquin, Emma step forward. They will march with the muster, eat from your stores (1000 kcal/day each), and stand in front of THE HERALD. They can die — Haven does not get them back, and the fire will be quieter. Tap again — Haven sends its own.

commit2Lines.text: 🛡️ Haven commits its own: Joaquin, Emma march with the muster. Not loaned. Not asked-for. Ours. The coalition counts 8 blades against THE HERALD — it needs 10.
